connectors.name: J7 Header
connectors.orderNote: No pin numbers (square pad is not a pin-1 mark); position 1 at the end nearer the USB-C connector, which is the bottom end of J7

connectors.name: J6 Header
connectors.orderNote: No pin numbers (square pad is not a pin-1 mark); position 1 at the end nearer the USB-C connector, which is the top end of J6

uncertain: Silkscreen labels are spaced closer together than the four holes of each header (e.g. TX1 and GND sit between holes); labels were mapped to holes in sequence, top label to top hole, which the image does not show explicitly
USB-C is on the opposite (left) edge, roughly level with the middle of the board, so the USB-nearest end differs between J7 (bottom end) and J6 (top end) by a small margin
notes: WisCore slot (board-to-board connector without pin labels), Battery and Solar Panel JST connectors (no pin labels) and Reset button skipped.
